Hadith.3183 - Al-Husayn ibn Zayd narrated from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
I heard him say: "

A man from the descendants of Musa, whose name is the name of the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) will emerge. He will be buried in the land of Tus, which is in Khurasan. He will be killed there by poison and buried there as a stranger. Whoever visits him, recognizing his right, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Exalted, will grant them the reward of one who spent (in charity) and fought (in battle) before the victory."
